editorial_position: 23 August is read as one honest cut between exhibitions closing and an object entering release, without treating either action as proof of cultural impact.

art_direction.dominant_mood: a Sunday closing ledger interrupted by one bright product opening
art_direction.background_logic: warm paper carries black closing rules while cobalt image fields and one halo-white interruption mark openings
art_direction.palette_logic: warm paper and carbon for the ledger, cobalt for active rooms, vermilion for final-day stamps, white for the release interruption
art_direction.type_scale_logic: large editorial Chinese headlines sit against compact date stamps; body copy stays at a readable 18px with restrained line length
art_direction.image_behavior: one source-led preview image per story where a publisher endpoint can be safely surfaced; original local closing-card visuals remain as accessible fallbacks
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: a broad cover, three spacious closing rooms, faster object and interaction signals, one bounded architecture watch, then a quiet ledger close
art_direction.core_visual_action: a vertical date rule repeatedly crosses story images, turning the same day into a sequence of doors closing and one box opening
art_direction.cover_composition: an oversized 23 is cut by a horizontal closing line with OPEN and CLOSE labels held apart
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: the functional issue index stays available while stories alternate between full-width image rooms and narrower ledger notes without requiring JavaScript
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: date cut, institutional archive, distributed city, changing matter, intimate manuscript, remastered object, QR threshold, domestic afterimage
art_direction.mobile_translation: the date rule becomes a left spine, figures retain captions, headings scale down without clipping, and all source links keep 44px targets
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: no hidden reading, no nested scroll, visible focus, stable anchors, source-image failure links, and complete no-JS access
art_direction.quiet_ending: a thin black closing rule and one unresolved sentence about what should be edited next

limitations: This issue is a retrospective non-production Preview: publication date is 2026-08-23, while research and content work are truthfully timestamped on 2026-08-24 after the canonical production window.
Manifest status and QA fields are reporting only and cannot authorize deployment.
Five source-image previews are displayed from publisher-hosted endpoints with click-through attribution; they are user-authorized for Preview display only and remain blocked for production rights.
The Fondation Cartier and Walters stories use original local information visuals because stable official source-image endpoints were not safely available during verification.
Designboom labels the DKA article as a readers submission; the issue separates page observation from any unsupported claim about the architect’s intent.
No qualifying new luxury-house runway event was added merely to satisfy a category quota, and 2026-08-24 Supreme, Stüssy and TMEX coverage was not repeated.
